# Storyboard fixtures

Inputs for `tests/test_storyboard.py` (`showtime new <template> <dir> --from-storyboard`).

- `level-4-en.md` and `fourier-zh.md` are excerpts, unchanged, from
  [understanding-ladder](https://github.com/ChangWenC/understanding-ladder) by ChangWenC (commit a1818704),
  under the MIT License: its copyright and permission notice is in `LICENSE-understanding-ladder`.
  `level-4-en.md` is the storyboard format of `skills/understanding-ladder/references/level-4-video.md`;
  `fourier-zh.md` is the storyboard of `examples/understanding-ladder/04-fourier-square-wave-level4.md`
  (Chinese headers, lengths in 秒, a toolchain table after it).
- `odd.md` was written for these tests (showtime's licence).
